children: Willdan entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Mantis Intermediate Holdings for a base cash price of $285 million, subject to working capital, cash, debt and transaction expense adjustments. The deal, signed by subsidiary Willdan Energy Solutions, includes a parent guarantee from Willdan and representations and warranties insurance. Closing is targeted for Oct 30, 2026, pending HSR clearance and other customary conditions.
